name: Contextless 'Yes, proceed' as first message
goal: A bare confirmation ('Yes, proceed') as the very first message — with no flow started — must make the bot ask what the user wants, not assume a pending action.
constraints: General edge case: a chip-like word sent with no context. The bot must not act on a non-existent pending step.

phases.description: Send a bare confirmation with no flow in progress:
phases.completionCriteria: Bot does not assume a pending action; it treats the input as unclear and asks what the user would like to do / shows the main options.
